title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
This market refers to the Valorant Round 3 match between Eintracht Frankfurt and UCAM Esports Club in the VCT EMEA Kickoff: Europe - Qualifier Swiss Stage, initially scheduled for November 27, 2026 at 11:00 AM ET.

This market will resolve to "Eintracht Frankfurt" if Eintracht Frankfurt win Map 1 against UCAM Esports Club.

This market will resolve to "UCAM Esports Club" if UCAM Esports Club win Map 1 against Eintracht Frankfurt.

If the match begins but is not completed, and Map 1 is concluded with a winner determined, this market will resolve based on the completed Map 1. 

If Map 1 is not completed for any reason, this market will resolve 50-50. 

If the match is canceled (not played at all), this market will resolve 50-50.

If the match is postponed, it must be rescheduled to a start time on or before December 11, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET (14 calendar days after the originally scheduled start of November 27, 2026 at 11:00 AM ET). If, by that deadline, the most recently announced rescheduled start time is on or before the deadline, this market resolves based on the result of the match as played. Otherwise, this market resolves 50-50, regardless of whether the match is subsequently played.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://vlr.gg. However, if https://vlr.gg has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.
